population: Schülerinnen und Schüler der Sekundarstufe in Deutschland, Klassen 10/11; publiziertes Alter 14–21 Jahre
design: individual randomization within classes; persistent sequential between-subjects experiment
outcome: T3SE four-item mean after second writing task; response scale 1–5
baseline_covariates: baseline WLE estimated from agent-written first essay
assignment_blueprint: Original available analysis counts; pooled missing-class level is an unresolved source convention, not a real classroom
scope: Agents generate their own baseline essay and questionnaire responses, followed by five writing-feedback-revision cycles and post-task writing self-efficacy.
timing_fidelity: Order and baseline generation timeout implemented; API latency is not human writing time. 90-minute exposure is not claimed.
